verses.gurmukhi: ੧੧ : ਪਾਰਸ ਤੇ ਪੱਥਰ ਸਰੀਖੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ
verses.translit_en: 11 : paaras te pa'thar sareekhe satigur te manmukh

en.bdb: Manmukh Cheat is like a stone

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: asaT dhaat ik dhaat hoi sabh ko ka(n)chan aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: With the touch of philosopher's stone the eight metals become one metal and people call it gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: roop anoop saroop hoi mul amul pa(n)ch paravaanai|

en.bdb: That beautiful metal becomes gold and the jewellers also prove it to be gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਥਰੁ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸੀਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਕੁਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: pathar paaras paraseeaai paaras hoi na kul abhimaanai|

en.bdb: Stone does not become philosopher's stone even after getting touched by it because the pride of family and hardness remains present in it (in fact the philosopher's stone is also but a stone).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਟੀਐ ਤੜ ਭੜ ਡੁਬੈ ਭਾਰ ਭੁਲਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: paanee a(n)dhar saTeeaai taR bhaR ddubai bhaar bhulaanai|

en.bdb: Thrown in water, the stone full of pride of its weight sinks at once.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਕਠੋਰ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਕੋਰੁ ਘੜੈ ਭੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: chit kaThor na bhijiee rahai nikor ghaRai bha(n)n jaanai|

en.bdb: Hard-hearted stone never gets wet and from inside remains as dry as it was earlier. It only learns how to break pitchers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਫੁਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਘਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: agee a(n)dhar fuT jai aharan ghan a(n)dhar hairaanai|

en.bdb: It cracks when put in fire and becomes brittle when hammered on anvil.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun gur upadhes na a(n)dhar aanai|

en.bdb: Such person's also even after listening to the teachings of the Guru in the holy congregation do not keep to their heart the importance of the teachings.
Showing fake affection, none can forcibly prove to be truthful.
